svg.text: DESAT detected inside the DUT's integrated driver.
DUT driver turns the IGBT off by itself (no tester in the loop).
Fault reported on the fiber Status link.
HW latch blocks Command pulses (&); overcurrent (IC) uses it too.
STM32 gets FAULT interrupt, logs timestamps, resets latch after inspection.
Measured: ① → ② → IC below 1 %, compared with the Wabtec ≈ 10 µs reference.
Fig. 1. Functional block diagram of the STM32-based IGBT test system (conceptual architecture; not a construction drawing).
Assumed: Wabtec slides 5–8 and team input (dual module, one shared 100 VAC input);
fiber protocol, connector pinout and gate test-point access to be confirmed with Wabtec.
